title: Trade Secret Protection and the Integration of Information Within Firms
authors: Ionela Andreicovici; Sara Bormann; Katharina Hombach
eligible_reason: Staggered adoption of the Uniform Trade Secrets Act by firms' HQ states: two in-sample adoption cohorts (Tennessee 2000, Pennsylvania 2004), four never-adopting states (MA, NJ, NY, TX) and 43 always-treated states over 1999-2009. Table 2 column 1 and Table 6 Panel C column 1 are static TWFE regressions of the outcome on utsa_dummy with firm FE and industry-by-year FE and no controls; Figure 2 is an unstacked eventdd event study with the same FE and no controls. All other columns add time-varying firm/state controls, interactions, SEM path models, or single-state subsamples.
design_notes: Firm-year panel from the Aberdeen CI database matched to Compustat (pseudonymized gvkey and sic2), 1999-2009, 2,164 firms, 15,522 obs, 49 HQ states. utsa_dummy = 1 once the HQ state has enacted UTSA (utsa_year). In-sample variation comes from only two states (TN switches in 2000 with a single pre-year; PA switches in 2004), so treated clusters are few (cluster = state). Always-treated states (adopted 1980-1998) are included in the regressions. Clustering by HQ state (49 clusters). The package also reports wild-cluster bootstrap (boottest) for Table 6 Panel B.
estimators_reported: TWFE static reghdfe with firm and industry-by-year FE (Tables 2, 6, 7)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: TN (2000) and PA (2004); 4 never-treated states; 43 states always treated within 1999-2009.
always_treated_note: 43 of 49 states adopted UTSA before 1999 and have utsa_dummy = 1 throughout; they contribute no identifying variation to CSA/BJS but are in the TWFE sample.

specs.treatment_var: utsa_dummy (0/1): = 1 if the firm's headquarter state has enacted the Uniform Trade Secrets Act in year t or earlier (state adoption year utsa_year); absorbing, never switches off in the data (firm-level switch count 0 or 1)
specs.treatment_definition: binary, absorbing state-level law indicator mapped to firms by HQ state; in-sample switchers: Tennessee (2000) and Pennsylvania (2004); never-treated in window: MA, NJ, NY, TX; all other states adopted before 1999 (always treated)
specs.code_line: 211 (globals: Treat line 47, FE line 51, Cluster line 50, DepVar line 52)
specs.outcome_label: EMS integration (weighted share of sites integrated into the firm's enterprise management system)
specs.sample_condition: full replication sample (data/sample_ready_to_test_MS.dta; reghdfe drops singletons)
specs.notes: reghdfe gwavg_erp_d_adopted utsa_dummy, absorb(gvkey sic2#year) cluster(group_state_id). Columns 2-3 add firm (and state) time-varying controls and are excluded.

specs.treatment_var: time_relative_to_utsa = year - utsa_year (event-time indicators generated by eventdd); underlying binary treatment utsa_dummy
specs.treatment_definition: binary, absorbing state-level law indicator mapped to firms by HQ state; in-sample switchers: Tennessee (2000) and Pennsylvania (2004); never-treated in window: MA, NJ, NY, TX; all other states adopted before 1999 (always treated)
specs.sample_condition: full replication sample; never-treated states have time_relative_to_utsa missing (eventdd treats them as pure controls)
specs.event_bins: leads(4) lags(4) accum: endpoint bins <= -4 and >= +4; relative time = year - utsa_year (always-treated states enter the +4 bin)
specs.notes: eventdd $DepVar, timevar(time_relative_to_utsa) method(hdfe, absorb(gvkey sic2#year) cluster(group_state_id)) lags(4) leads(4) accum baseline(-1). No controls. Table 3 (line 235) is the same event-time specification with the full control set and is excluded.

specs.treatment_var: utsa_dummy (0/1): = 1 if the firm's headquarter state has enacted the Uniform Trade Secrets Act in year t or earlier (state adoption year utsa_year); absorbing, never switches off in the data (firm-level switch count 0 or 1)
specs.treatment_definition: binary, absorbing state-level law indicator mapped to firms by HQ state; in-sample switchers: Tennessee (2000) and Pennsylvania (2004); never-treated in window: MA, NJ, NY, TX; all other states adopted before 1999 (always treated)
specs.outcome_label: Alternative EMS integration measure (Table 6 Panel C, site-level characteristics aggregated)
specs.notes: reghdfe erp_group2 utsa_dummy, absorb(gvkey sic2#year) cluster(group_state_id). Columns 2-3 add controls (excluded).

data_access_detail: Analysis dataset shipped with pseudonymized firm/industry IDs (sample_ready_to_test_MS.dta); raw CI Database (Aberdeen) and Compustat are licensed; site-level data not disclosed.
screener_notes: Only two treated states; the leverage screen (effective clusters >= 10, max cluster share <= 0.25) should be checked, since identification rests on TN and PA firm-years. Industry-by-year FE (sic2#year) is a time-invariant characteristic interacted with calendar time and is allowed.
